co_primary.band: ell_L(first-up)/ell_U(last-down) crossings; censored/regime edges excluded; IoU + per-edge + Hausdorff
co_primary.combined_rule: student-blind CI<0 on map RMSE AND each present in-regime band edge AND student/teacher<=1.5x
co_primary.name: map_and_band_recovery

critic_head.note: J-regression head defines selection (BCE cannot); success head optional

history_policy.action_note: grasp index + free-arm length (the action) included in the student input (A-17)

honest_nulls.Q1: argmax shift <2 cells / wrong sign -> NO-GO
honest_nulls.Q2: student & teacher regret CI overlaps blind -> conditioning does not discriminate
honest_nulls.Q3: frozen not better than blind -> NO (or NOT-ESTABLISHED if overlapping)

multi_seed_note: report seed variability across training_seeds; eval-draw bootstrap LABELED conditional-on-models (A-16)

bootstrap.label: LABELED conditional on the trained models; multiple training seeds report seed variability (A-16)

primary.formula: regret(s) = max_g E[J|s,g] - E[J|s,g_selected] on winner-only evaluation
primary.name: selection_regret
primary.precedence: PASS if student & teacher regret CI< blind; INCONCLUSIVE if CI overlaps; report null
primary.ratio_pairs: invariance controls (ratio-cluster uncertainty), not extra unique groups (A-15)

source_encoder.note: FROZEN lift-and-clear task-only encoder; distal TEST disjoint from source TRAIN+VAL

equal_budget.report: equal-update budget AND trainable-param-count difference; multiple seeds

transfer.frozen_state: requires_grad=False; head optimizer excludes encoder tensors; encoder+scaler hash identical pre/post
transfer.rule: YES iff frozen NON-INFERIOR to scratch (CI upper of (frozen-scratch) map RMSE < 0.05) AND BETTER than blind ((blind-frozen) CI excludes 0 positive); NO iff frozen not better than blind; else NOT-ESTABLISHED
